summary: Comprehensive testing of Staff Mobile View and QR Code/Public Mileage features for Quick Wing fleet management app. All backend tests passed (9/10, 1 skipped). All frontend UI tests passed. Staff Mobile View renders correctly on mobile viewport with 3 functional tabs (Home, Bookings, Lift) and persists after page refresh. QR code endpoint generates valid PNG images. Public mileage page loads without authentication and allows mileage submission. Service alerts trigger correctly when mileage approaches service_due_mileage.
passed_tests: 1. Staff Mobile View renders on mobile viewport (width < 768px) - PASSED
2. Staff Mobile View has 3 tabs: Home, Bookings, Lift - PASSED
3. All 3 tabs are functional and switch correctly - PASSED
4. Staff Mobile View persists after page refresh - PASSED
5. Home tab shows Dashboard with Live Fleet Status (2-column grid) - PASSED
6. Bookings tab shows Car Bookings with time slots - PASSED
7. Lift tab shows Request a Lift form - PASSED
8. Public mileage page loads at /{tenant}/vehicle/{id}/mileage - PASSED
9. Public mileage page works without authentication - PASSED
10. Public mileage submission works without login - PASSED
11. Service alert triggers when mileage approaches service_due_mileage - PASSED
critical_code_review_comments: Staff Mobile View correctly renders for staff/driver role users on mobile viewport (<768px)
The 3-tab interface (Home, Bookings, Lift) matches the design requirements with white bg, blue accents, amber highlights
2-column grid layout for vehicle cards in Live Fleet Status section
QR code endpoint at /api/vehicles/{id}/qr generates valid PNG images
Public mileage page at /{tenant}/vehicle/{id}/mileage loads without authentication
Service alert logic correctly triggers when mileage is within 1000km of service_due_mileage
All data-testid attributes are properly implemented for testing
seed_data_creation: Used existing test vehicle (Van 3, STD-003) in standard-fleet tenant for testing. Mileage was updated during testing from 45490 to 45495 km.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Staff Mobile View and QR Code/Public Mileage features fully tested and working. Key features verified: 1) Staff Mobile View renders for staff/driver roles on mobile viewport with 3 tabs (Home, Bookings, Lift), 2) View persists after page refresh via localStorage flag, 3) QR code endpoint generates PNG images linking to /{tenant}/vehicle/{id}/mileage, 4) Public mileage page works without authentication, 5) Service alerts trigger when mileage approaches service_due_mileage.
